name: Python + UV + C Compiler Dev Env
postCreateCommand: sudo apt update && sudo apt install -y build-essential && curl -LsSf https://astral.sh/uv/install.sh | sh && echo 'export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH"' >> ~/.bashrc && echo 'export UV_INDEX_URL=https://pypi.tuna.tsinghua.edu.cn/simple' >> ~/.bashrc && source ~/.bashrc && uv python install 3.12 && uv venv --python 3.12
